fatal_blockers: The compared sections use fundamentally different buried cover architectures: monolithic soil versus membrane composite/compacted clay. A radar difference cannot be attributed to depth alone.
The authoritative instrumented lysimeter is only 10 m wide, below the required clean 20 m footprint.
Exact WGS84 polygons and numerical boundary uncertainty for both original ACAP sections were not recovered.
Public records do not confirm that the original 2000 test sections remained physically unchanged throughout a usable Sentinel-1 observation period.
The landfill remained active and later closure/construction programs occurred, creating an unresolved disturbance risk.
